name: Bishop Falss
source:
A High priest of the Elemia Church. He acts as the leader of all the churches on each floating island., including Nemo. He was not originally from the area, but ever since he joined the Elemia Church, people called him the Saint of Elemia Church. After 15 years, he reached the top of the Church's heirarchy.

He is full of affection and believes the goal of the Church is to descend the goddess of the Trio of Elemia to lead people to happiness.

Voiced by: Susumu Kaseda (Japanese), Jamieson Price (English)

[Edited from [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/artonelico/]Ar Tonelico Official Site[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Kyle Clancy, and he was previously a leader in Platina with Leard. He was exiled for attempting to ally with Mir.[/spoiler]
